mapper.select: SELECT i.item_text AS 'name', i.item_value AS 'value' FROM sys_dict d LEFT JOIN sys_dict_item i ON d.id = i.dict_id WHERE d.dict_code = 'screen_left_two_class_name'

SELECT sltd.class_name AS xData, sltm.title AS NAME, SUM(sltd.value) AS total_value, CONCAT( sltm.color_one, ',', sltm.color_two) AS colors FROM screen_left_two_data sltd JOIN screen_left_two_main sltm ON sltd.group_id = sltm.id WHERE sltd.year >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY sltd.class_name, sltm.title, sltm.color_one, sltm.color_two ORDER BY sltd.class_name, sltm.title;
